with the act, then it can be considered an actual suicide attempt. There does not have to be any injury or harm, just

Inferring Intent: even if an individual denies intent/wish to die, it may be inferred clinically from the behaviour or circumstances. For example, a highly lethal act that is clearly not an accident so no other intent but suicide can be

inferred (e.g. gunshot to the head, jumping from window of a high floor/story). Also, if someone denies intent to die, but they thought that what they did could be lethal, intent may be inferred. Have you made a suicide attempt? Have you done anything to harm yourself?
